name: switchyard-mod
description: Shows switchyard account usage and switches the running session to another account.

background.title: Accounts pane: background
background.description: Background color of the /accounts pane. Empty keeps the default. A color name (black) or hex (#1e1e1e).

text.title: Accounts pane: text color
text.description: Color of the text in the /accounts pane. Empty follows your Claude theme. A color name or hex.

usageLow.title: Accounts pane: usage below 70%
usageLow.description: Color of a usage bar below 70%. Empty uses your theme's success color.

usageMedium.title: Accounts pane: usage 70-89%
usageMedium.description: Color of a usage bar from 70% to 89%. Empty uses your theme's warning color.

usageHigh.title: Accounts pane: usage from 90%
usageHigh.description: Color of a usage bar from 90%. Empty uses your theme's error color.

borderActive.title: Accounts pane: active account border
borderActive.description: Border and name color of the active account. Empty uses your theme's success color.

border.title: Accounts pane: other borders
border.description: Border color of the other cards. Empty uses your theme's subtle color.
